name: jesse_momentum_v2
status: PRE-REGISTERED before any backtest on market data (only a synthetic-candle speed probe was run)
scope: Research and simulation only. Jesse 3.5.3 (salehmir/jesse:3.5.3) is the research engine; Tycho/NautilusTrader stays the execution system. Nothing here changes Tycho's dependencies, frozen protocol (research/protocol.json), momentum v1 ledger or paper safety controls. No credentials, no orders, no activation.
known_contamination: The author read docs/MOMENTUM_V1_RESULTS.md (Tycho v1) before writing this protocol: long-only alt breakouts degraded on holdout A, trend rules were not distinguishable from noise.

Binance USDT-M perpetual history 2020-01..2026-09 was used by Tycho v1 (12-coin dev universe and holdout A of 538 other perps). It is INSPECTED data: the walk-forward below is a historical diagnostic, never an untouched holdout.
Binance spot 2017-08..2019-12 for BTC ETH BNB XRP ADA LTC LINK TRX DOGE was Tycho v1 holdout B: INSPECTED, excluded from this holdout.

data.source: https://data.binance.vision public monthly archives (klines 1d and 1m, USDT-M fundingRate), sha256 CHECKSUM verified per file; symbol lists from the archive S3 listing (includes delisted symbols)
data.hard_cutoff_utc: 2026-10-01 00:00 (monthly archives up to 2026-09). The Tycho frozen prospective window (2026-10-26 20:00 UTC .. 2027-04-24 20:00 UTC) is never read.
data.gaps: missing 1m rows are filled with flat zero-volume candles (Jesse needs contiguous 1m rows); every filled minute is counted in data/manifest.json
data.excluded_symbols: stablecoins (USDC BUSD TUSD USDP FDUSD DAI EUR AEUR USDS PAX UST USTC USDE), index/composite contracts (BTCDOM DEFI FOOTBALL BLUEBIRD), dated futures (symbols with '_'), leveraged spot tokens (UP/DOWN/BULL/BEAR suffixes)

universe.chunks: calendar half-years (Jan 1 and Jul 1 00:00 UTC); membership fixed at chunk start
universe.eligibility: daily history >= 60 days before chunk start and a daily bar on the day before chunk start
universe.rank: median daily quote volume over the 60 days before chunk start; top 15
universe.capital: 15 equal sub-accounts per chunk (empty slots hold cash), capital rebalanced equally at every chunk start; chunk ends at the half-year end or at the symbol's last archived minute (delisting), where any open position is closed at that minute's close

dev_walk_forward.folds: expanding window: for each test half-year from 2021-H1, pick the grid cell with the highest Sharpe of daily net portfolio returns on all earlier chunks (minimum 30 closed trades, else the cell with most trades); stitch the out-of-sample halves
dev_walk_forward.classification: HISTORICAL WALK-FORWARD DIAGNOSTIC on inspected data

final_holdout.market: Binance spot USDT pairs as a perpetual-price proxy (perps did not exist), excluding the nine Tycho holdout-B coins
final_holdout.costs: same fee/slippage rule; funding ASSUMED at the 0.01%/8h baseline (longs pay, shorts receive)
final_holdout.params: the grid cell with the highest dev Sharpe over 2020-H1..2026-H2, frozen before the holdout is read
final_holdout.access: read once, only for candidates that pass every walk-forward criterion; never used for tuning; marked INSPECTED afterwards
final_holdout.classification: UNTOUCHED HOLDOUT (different instrument and era: weak but clean)

execution.timeframe: 4h decisions on Jesse candles built from 1m; market orders at the decision bar close, stops on Jesse's intrabar simulation
execution.slippage_per_side: by chunk-start median daily quote volume: >= 1e9 USD 2 bp, >= 2e8 USD 5 bp, else 10 bp (passed to Jesse as part of the fee)
execution.funding: perps: actual Binance settlements; a position pays/receives when opened_at <= settlement < closed_at, amount = qty * 1m open at settlement * rate * side; deducted from sub-account equity after the Jesse run (Jesse has no funding model)
execution.sizing_H1_H2: risk 1% of sub-account equity per trade on the initial stop distance, notional capped at 1x sub-account equity

H1_momentum_pullback.claim: In an established uptrend, a short-term RSI dip is followed by trend resumption that pays more than costs.
H1_momentum_pullback.entry: flat and close > EMA300 and EMA50 > EMA300 and close/close[-180] - 1 > 0 and RSI14 < rsi_entry
H1_momentum_pullback.exit: stop at entry - stop_atr*ATR14; or RSI14 > 70; or close < EMA300; or 60 bars held

H2_breakout_continuation.claim: A volume-confirmed break of the n-bar high above the long trend continues far enough to pay costs.
H2_breakout_continuation.entry: flat and close > max(high of the previous n bars) and volume > 1.5 * median(volume of previous 30 bars) and close > EMA300
H2_breakout_continuation.exit: chandelier stop = max(previous stop, highest close since entry - k*ATR14), initial stop close - k*ATR14

H3_relative_strength.claim: Cross-sectional relative strength among liquid coins persists for a week: long the strongest k, short the weakest k earns a spread net of costs and funding.
H3_relative_strength.direction: long/short, dollar-balanced by construction (k longs, k shorts, equal notional)
H3_relative_strength.rule: every Monday 00:00 UTC rank chunk members with a valid score by close[-6]/close[-6-L] - 1; long the top k, short the bottom k, flat otherwise; needs >= 2k+1 scored coins

baselines_run_first: BTCUSDT perpetual buy and hold (1x, with funding), per chunk
equal-weight buy and hold of each chunk's 15 members (1x each sub-account, with funding)
each hypothesis rule itself is the non-ML baseline for the ML comparison

walk_forward_pass_criteria_all_required.block_bootstrap: circular 30-day blocks, 2000 reps, seed 1729: 5th percentile of mean daily net return > 0
walk_forward_pass_criteria_all_required.null_definition: H1/H2: same trade count and holding bars per symbol-chunk at random non-overlapping 4h entries, statistic = mean net close-to-close trade return (fee, slippage and funding applied); H3: scores permuted among eligible coins at each rebalance, statistic = Sharpe of the vectorized weekly long/short book. 1000 reps, seed 1729, p = (1 + #null >= observed)/(1 + reps); 0.0167 = 0.05/3 hypotheses
robustness_bounded: at least 3 of 4 grid cells have positive net Sharpe over 2021-H1..2026-H2 at fixed parameters
one-bar delayed entry variant of the walk-forward choice: net CAGR > 0
dropping the symbol with the largest out-of-sample profit: net CAGR > 0
at least half of the out-of-sample calendar years 2021..2026 have net return >= 0

ml.model: scikit-learn LogisticRegression(C=1.0, L2), features standardized on the training fold only
ml.applies_to: H1 and H2 (event signals); H3 is a ranking with few independent weekly observations and is excluded by rule
ml.label: trade net return after fee, slippage and funding > 0
ml.training_rows: trades of the walk-forward-selected cell from earlier chunks that closed at least 10 days before the test chunk starts (purge + embargo)
ml.decision: inside the Jesse strategy at each entry signal: enter only if predicted p >= the training-fold win rate
ml.independence_gate: fit only if the fold has >= 300 training trades, >= 150 distinct entry days and >= 60 trades in the minority class; the comparison is reported only if >= 6 test folds pass the gate, otherwise ML is SKIPPED_INSUFFICIENT_OBSERVATIONS
ml.pass: ML variant must meet every walk-forward criterion AND beat its non-ML rule on stitched out-of-sample Sharpe

compute_budget.memory: one Jesse backtest process at a time, container limit 1.5 GB

consequence_of_pass: CANDIDATE_FOR_NEW_PREREGISTERED_PROSPECTIVE_PAPER_TRIAL, owner approval required; never auto-activated; real money stays disabled
consequence_of_fail: REJECTED and kept in trials.jsonl; no re-tuning on the holdout; a changed idea needs a new pre-registration
amendments: 2026-10-26, before any market-data backtest (implementation clarification, no results seen): Jesse computes non-sequential indicators on the last warm_up_candles (330) 4h candles, so EMA300/ATR14/RSI14 are evaluated on a fixed 330-bar window both inside the strategies and in the ML feature function.

2026-10-26, before any market-data backtest (implementation clarification): in Jesse a flip of an H3 position (long->short or short->long) closes at the rebalance bar and opens the new side on the next 4h close; entries from flat happen at the rebalance bar. The random-entry/permutation nulls and their observed statistics are computed on 4h close-to-close prices (vectorized), not on Jesse fills, so they test the signal rather than Jesse execution details.

2026-10-26, before any market-data backtest: walk-forward 'half_years_nonneg' is evaluated on calendar years of the stitched OOS series as written in robustness_bounded (at least half of years 2021..2026 with net return >= 0).
